findings.detail: Deconvolves chimeric DDA LC-MS/MS spectra, which is a different acquisition modality from GC-MS EI deconvolution.
Reconstructs pseudo-MS/MS spectra from LC-MS AIF chromatograms rather than deconvolving GC-MS EI chromatograms.
Joins eRah compound identities and match factors to per-sample integrated areas but does not consolidate the upstream statistical results required by the stage goal.
Calibrates LC-MS retention indices with N-alkyl-pyridinium standards for HPLC/UHPLC matching, which is a different chromatographic technique from the requested GC-MS RI calibration.
Matches LC-MS features to HPLC/UHPLC databases with N-alkyl-pyridinium indices rather than performing the requested GC-MS RI calibration and filtering.
Runs univariate group tests with FDR correction on normalized feature matrices but omits the query's multivariate analysis.
